parameters.name: num_furnaces
parameters.description: Number of available furnaces / total furnace capacity available for allocation

parameters.name: processing_time_per_method
parameters.description: Processing time in hours per furnace for each steelmaking method

parameters.name: fuel_cost_per_method
parameters.description: Fuel expense per furnace for each steelmaking method

parameters.name: output_per_furnace
parameters.description: Steel output in tons produced by one furnace, independent of method

parameters.name: minimum_required_output
parameters.description: Minimum required steel output in tons

variables.name: method_allocation
variables.description: Amount of furnace capacity allocated to each steelmaking method

variables.name: total_fuel_expense
variables.description: Total fuel expense of the plan

variables.name: furnace_method_assignment
variables.description: Detailed allocation of each furnace to each steelmaking method

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_fuel_expense
constraints.description: Total fuel expense must be nonnegative

constraints.name: nonnegative_assignment
constraints.description: Detailed furnace-to-method assignment must be nonnegative when used

constraints.name: total_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total furnace allocation across all methods cannot exceed available furnace capacity

constraints.name: planning_horizon_limit
constraints.description: Chosen allocation must fit within the available planning horizon using method processing times

constraints.name: minimum_output_requirement
constraints.description: Total steel produced must meet or exceed the minimum required output

constraints.name: fuel_expense_definition
constraints.description: Total fuel expense is determined from method allocations and method-specific fuel costs

constraints.name: assignment_aggregation
constraints.description: Detailed furnace-by-method assignment must aggregate consistently to method-level allocation when used

objectives.name: fuel_expense_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total fuel expense while meeting production demand and respecting furnace capacity and planning horizon limits

final_objective.description: Minimize total fuel expense for the furnace allocation plan while satisfying production demand, furnace capacity, and planning horizon limits.
